tasks.label: Content Portals Dashboard - Run
tasks.command: DASHBOARD_ROOT="${workspaceFolder}"; DASHBOARD_VENV="${DASHBOARD_VENV:-/home/vscode/.venvs/content-portals-dashboard}"; if [ ! -x "$DASHBOARD_VENV/bin/python" ]; then bash "$DASHBOARD_ROOT/devcontainer-integration/post-create-dashboard.sh"; fi; "$DASHBOARD_VENV/bin/python" -m streamlit run "$DASHBOARD_ROOT/app.py" --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port 8501 --server.headless true
